# Author

A byline: portrait or initials, name, role and an optional bio.

```tsx
import { Author } from '@kafka-ds/react'
```

## When to use it

- Under the title of an article and at the end of a text.

## When not to

- For members or contacts: it is for authorship.
- Adding a portrait that adds no recognition: initials are fine.

## Examples

### Initials and role

Without a portrait, the initials stand in.

```tsx
<Author name="Gabriel Rodríguez" role="Director de Altazor" />
```

### Portrait, link and bio

The portrait is decorative: the name beside it carries the meaning.

```tsx
<div className="max-w-md">
  <Author name="Gabriel Rodríguez" role="Director de Altazor" image="/avatar.svg" href="#equipo" bio="Escritor y tallerista. Dirige Altazor, un espacio de escritura creativa." />
</div>
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` (required) | `string` |  |  |
| `role` | `string` |  | Role or tagline, for example "Coordinador de Altazor". |
| `image` | `string` |  | Portrait. If missing, the initials are shown. |
| `href` | `string` |  | Link to the author's page. |
| `bio` | `ReactNode` |  | A short biography, shown below the byline. |
| …rest | `HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement>` | | Everything else is passed to the underlying element. |

## Accessibility

- **Portrait is decorative** (`alt=""`): the name beside it carries the meaning. Initials are `aria-hidden`.
- **Link:** if `href` is given, the name is a real underlined link with `rel="author"`.
- **Contrast:** all text is 4.5:1 or better.

## Content

- Keep the role to one line.
